messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Realtime stream endpoint /v1/stream p99 > 2.5s over 5m (SLO 1.5s). Paging on-call: matt. Dash: https://dash.redwood.local/d/streams/p99?from=now-10m

matt: i'm looking... there's a sharp tail starting ~14:02 UTC. pulling traces and router queues.

sana: any customer noise?

matt: not yet in support, but metrics show inflight streaming sessions spiked ~3x; router queue depth increased. p95 ~+300ms, p99 ~+2s.

liam: kube autoscaler shows no recent scale events. pods are ready; GPU/CPU not saturated. could be kvcache pressure or runtime event-loop stalls.

matt: quick prom checks:
```
sum(rate(stream_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)
increase(stream_inflight_sessions[5m])
```
queue depth correlated with p99 spike.

sana: show pod logs tail.

matt: logs show repeating "checkpoint flush timeout" and "client send stalled". excerpt:
```
runtime-0a7f: WARN checkpoint flush timeout=120s model=redwood-13b kvcache
runtime-0a7f: ERROR stream write timeout: connection reset by peer
```

liam: sounds like KV eviction thrash. any recent runtime rollouts? kernels/quant changes?

sana: we rolled batched-streaming backend yesterday (rollout r-2026-03-14-23).

matt: mitigation proposals:
- roll back r-2026-03-14-23 for streaming path
- route new sessions to model-compact-8b to reduce KV pressure
- temporary throttling of non-enterprise streaming traffic by 20%
- short canary to validate

liam: applying route split: new streaming sessions -> model-compact-8b 80%, redwood-13b 20% (id rt-7902).

matt: infra, check redis/memcached evictions.

opsbot: autoscaler: no scale-up in last 10m; free GPUs=2.

sana: redis eviction rate spiked at 14:01 UTC; memory pressure ~86%, eviction counter climbing.

matt: actions: increase kvcache eviction threshold, add +1 cache node, disable prefix persistence briefly.

liam: patching configmap kvcache.eviction_threshold 95 -> applied (cfg-557). scaling cache pool +1 (job cache-scale-99 submitted).

matt: toggling runtime.feature.streaming_persist_prefix=false -> applied.

liam: cache scale job succeeded, new node ready 14:10 UTC.

matt: observed p99 drop from 2.8s -> 1.7s within 2 minutes of routing change. p95 down to ~350ms. still above SLO but improving.

eva: CS reports Acme showing intermittent stream timeouts starting ~14:05 UTC. ticket P2.

kelly-cs: opening bridge and notifying account team.

matt: starting rollback canary rb-2026-03-15-14 (5% traffic) to verify rollback safe.

sana: canary 5m results: no regression, streaming p99 steady ~1.1s.

liam: full rollback complete at 14:18 UTC; route back to pre-rollout binaries.

matt: incident created INC-2026-0315-392. PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood.local/INC-392

matt: summary: transient SLO breach ~12m; p99 peak 2.8s; root cause likely KV cache eviction + rollout interaction. Mitigations: routing pref to compact model, kvcache threshold bump, +1 cache node, disable prefix persistence, rollback rollout, throttle non-enterprise.

kelly-cs: will update Acme and provide timeline.

eva: preparing customer-facing summary and next steps.

matt: handing monitoring to oncall for 30m. if p99 rises -> page infra + eng-runtime and escalate.

opsbot: alert silence applied for 20m by matt.

matt: posting postmortem stub to #postmortems. Owners: runtime team (sana, liam) for RCA; CS for customer comms. :white_check_mark:
